status: IN design candidate, unimplemented and UNEXECUTED; no encoding/technology selected
canonical_owner: Existing fenced kernel/writer. Remote membership, leases and observations are canonical objects/projections under that owner; no node or fabric database creates another authority.

accepted_constraints.D020: Required user-toggleable automatic writer takeover in first-party remote/full plugin; core is single-node, monotonic fence/store seam, no default consensus
accepted_constraints.D022: Aggressive/Full/Lazy plus checkpoint/interrupt/drain; no instant offline Stop or external rollback
accepted_constraints.D024: Productive continuity preserves current authority/evidence/accounting; no zero RPO/RTO claim
accepted_constraints.D029: Operator-provisioned destination trusted launch; provider credentials never move in capsules

fields.object_type: string: existing canonical object or artifact type
fields.content_digest: exact bytes integrity identity; internal project trust domain only

ArtifactRef.external_representation: audience-scoped opaque_handle with fresh authorization; do not expose content_digest or globally correlated stable ids
ArtifactRef.integrity_nonproof: Digest proves only matching bytes under chosen algorithm assumptions, not authentic origin or authority

ContentEnvelope_shape_owner: R-Q candidate-contracts.json, extending R-P provenance dimensions. Exact Q base uses project_and_audience and privacy_domain_id; project_id is not a base alias.
CopyRecord_shape_owner: R-Q CopyRecord, referenced without renaming or replacing its fields/statuses
media_extension_owner: R-T; representation/transform/loss extensions preserve base fields and current rights. No transport-owned media object.
workspace_binding_owner: R-Y WorkspaceBinding; fabric carries its immutable reference and qualified materialization references, not a competing workspace registry

field_alias_map.X: same internal ArtifactRef; no renamed digest
field_alias_map.rule: Digests stay inside authorized privacy domain; external scoped opaque_handle is not ArtifactRef without fresh resolution

field_alias_map.T: ContentEnvelope.project_and_audience, with privacy_domain_id; corrected T base matches Q exactly; project_id is not a base alias
field_alias_map.rule: MemoryProjection.project_id is separate and not a substitute for ContentEnvelope base

field_alias_map.P: scope constraint dimensions; Q adds explicit field
field_alias_map.rule: Authorize metadata before exposing digest/equality/source locator

field_alias_map.T: same names plus declared media facets
field_alias_map.rule: Transformation does not declassify or confer authority

field_alias_map.X: authority_carried_none=true; minimum control refs resolved at current canonical boundary
field_alias_map.rule: Reference possession is never a permit

X adds TransferBinding/ExposureIntent only; durable intent precedes transfer/publication and does not add Q CopyRecord statuses or observed-copy truth. Existing rights, lineage, inventory and accounting owners are preserved.

field_alias_map.Y: WorkspaceBinding and Materialization exactly as reference contracts
field_alias_map.X: TransferBinding.workspace_binding_ref; ArtifactRef references only inside authorized domain
field_alias_map.rule: Historical binding/materialization receipt is not current authority; coherent capture requires qualified immutable snapshot or all-writer quiescence; before/after equal hashes alone do not exclude ABA

NodeIdentity.proof_limit: Software-key possession cannot establish unique physical hardware or exclude administrator compromise

Lease.physical_nonoverlap: If required, independently observed quiescence is mandatory before replacement; unreachable old process means hold

PlacementReceipt.eligibility: All required conditions established before private metadata or content leaves source; no scalar score overrides a floor

ordering: authorize bounded metadata, exact recipient, purpose and current control/hydration scope before disclosure

before any relevant private manifest metadata or chunk leaves the sender, durably register a separate exposure intent and potential-copy inventory obligation through the existing canonical owner, referring to expected CopyRecord identity, lineage and existing reservation; assert neither present nor delivered
deliver and validate the minimum control manifest first, then transfer only authorized chunks into quarantine
verify exact representation, lengths, integrity, provenance and scoped materialization
recheck current rights, deletion-inventory cut, grant and work/pause fences at the protected publication gate
publish only if durable registered intent and current checks are valid, including after restart
independently observe publication/copies/effects and settle evidence/accounting; unresolved publication remains publication_unknown
TransferBinding.publication_recovery: Crashes before/after protected publication preserve the same operation/transfer identity, exposure intent and reservation. publication_unknown requires reconciliation, never assumed absence, a new blind transfer/effect or premature reservation release.
TransferBinding.deletion_inventory_race: An inventory cut must include durable unresolved exposure intents and their possible copies. A later or stale-cut intent cannot bypass current revocation/deletion checks; reconcile or refuse before publication. Intent registration is not evidence that the expected copy exists.
TransferBinding.local_private_staging: May precede registration only within already authorized local scope; no recipient disclosure has yet occurred

checks: atomic gate relative to irreversible acceptance
ReceiverFence.no_false_promise: Canonical revocation alone does not prove a disconnected receiver stopped

OperationReceipt.dedup_rule: Same stable ID/same exact bytes returns disposition; same ID/changed bytes refuses; missing ACK queries, not new effect
OperationReceipt.sink_body_digest_rule: exact_body_digest is immutable data bound atomically to the same (receiver_scope,effect_id) key with mutation/result. Matching digest replays the disposition; altered digest conflicts and never creates a new idempotency namespace.

RecoveryBinding.reservation_rule: Unknown liabilities remain attached to existing outstanding reservations; they are not counted again as a second ledger or reset on recovery

unknown_reason: No runtime execution or qualification performed; contracts and profiles are candidates

WorkspaceBinding_reference_contract.current_permission_rule: Historical authority_decision_ref is not current authority; resolve current GoalSpec/grants/rights/fences at each protected admission
WorkspaceBinding_reference_contract.required_unknown_rule: Refuse stale/ambiguous/missing required identity rather than guess, fetch, index or invoke a model

Materialization_reference_contract.rule: Creation/copy receipt does not grant writer, execution, process or reservation authority; deleted checkout does not delete task/source evidence

workspace_contract_status: Latest finalized R-Y research proposal consumed; still unratified/unimplemented/UNEXECUTED, no second canonical owner

ExposureIntent.status: X transport-specific proposed record; registered by existing canonical owner, not a Q CopyRecord status or second ledger
ExposureIntent.copy_truth: Expected copy reference is an inventory obligation, not observed copy truth. No planned/staged status is added to Q CopyRecord, and intent claims neither present nor delivered. Copy observation remains UNKNOWN until independently evidenced.
ExposureIntent.publication_truth: Publication attempt may become publication_unknown after a crash or missing observation. Reconcile under same identity and reservation; only independent evidence establishes publication or nonpublication.
ExposureIntent.gate: Precommit intent, potential-copy inventory obligation, lineage and reservation before sender release of any scoped private metadata/manifest/chunk. Remote quarantine is disclosure. Separately require fresh rights/fence/inventory-cut checks and verified material before task publication, including after restart.
ExposureIntent.owner: Existing canonical kernel/writer; reservation, lineage and copy records retain their existing owners

rules: Project-private logical mapping, no arbitrary filesystem path or URL capability exposed
External opaque handle is audience/purpose-scoped and non-authorizing
Resolve current rights before metadata lookup, hydration or transfer
Content address identifies exact declared bytes, not availability, authority or durable retention

idle_observation_contract.sensitivity_control: For each probe use an enabled inert synthetic control with the same observer configuration, reset procedure and baseline; retain expected/detected receipts before trusting an absence claim. No actual provider/network call.
idle_observation_contract.unknown_rule: Blind, failed, missing or uncalibrated detector means UNKNOWN, never zero. Ordinary task acceptance is not probe calibration.
